title: Local distillation from Reed Muller codes unfolding
summary: We generalize the unfolding of a Reed Muller distillation factory of Ruiz et. al. by exhibiting the algebraic structure that the unfolding is based on. We describe a 2D local layout for the Z stabilizers of a distance 4 Reed Muller distillation factory and a 3D local layout for the Z stabilizer of a distance 4 and a distance 7 Reed Muller distillation factory.
